# Tulyro

> Free browser-only tools. No signup. No watermark. Nothing you enter is sent to a server.
> Every tool runs entirely in the visitor's browser. Results are informational estimates, not
> professional advice.

## Entity facts

- Name: Tulyro
- Website: https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/
- Contact: Tulyrotools@gmail.com
- Model: free browser-only tools; no accounts, no backend, no database, no watermark, no popups.
- Full detail: https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Tools

- [Age Calculator](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/calculators/age-calculator/): Calculate exact age in years, months and days from a date of birth. See total days lived and the next birthday.
- [EMI Calculator](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/calculators/emi-calculator/): Estimate a monthly EMI, total interest and total payment for an Indian loan in rupees.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/calculators/mortgage-calculator/): Estimate a US mortgage payment with total interest and total payment in dollars.
- [BMI Calculator](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/calculators/bmi-calculator/): Check adult BMI from height and weight in metric or imperial units, with screening categories explained.
- [CGPA to Percentage](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/calculators/cgpa-to-percentage/): Convert a 10-point CGPA to an estimated percentage using the CBSE ×9.5 convention. The result is an estimate.
- [Word Counter](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/text/word-counter/): Count words, characters, sentences and reading time as you type.
- [Text to Speech](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/text/text-to-speech/): Listen to text read aloud with voices already in the browser. No audio download.
- [Fancy Text Generator](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/text/fancy-text-generator/): Turn plain text into copyable Unicode styles — bold, italic, script, monospace and more.
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/dev/base64-encoder-decoder/): Encode UTF-8 text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to text, entirely in the browser.
- [Invoice Generator](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/tools/invoice-generator/): Create a simple invoice in the browser and print or save it as PDF. No watermark.
- [Fake Text Generator](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/fun/fake-text-generator/): Make a generic chat mockup for sketches, presentations and entertainment. Export PNG.

## Guides

- [How to Calculate EMI by Hand](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/guides/how-to-calculate-emi/): Worked reducing-balance EMI examples with verified numbers.
- [How to Calculate Your Age in Days](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/guides/how-to-calculate-age-in-days/): Verified day counts, leap-year handling, and why dividing by 365.25 gives the wrong answer.
- [CGPA to Percentage: The CBSE ×9.5 Rule, Explained](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/guides/cgpa-to-percentage-cbse-9-5-rule/): What the ×9.5 rule means, where it applies, and where it does not.
- [EMI Calculator vs Mortgage Calculator: Which One to Use](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/guides/emi-vs-mortgage-calculator/): Same formula, different currency, formatting, and context — how to pick.
- [How to Choose an EMI Calculator](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/guides/how-to-choose-emi-calculator/): Five checks that separate honest EMI calculators from traps — total interest, amortization, prepayment, currency, disclosed limits.
- [Calculate Age in Excel](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/guides/calculate-age-in-excel/): DATEDIF, YEARFRAC and the quick method for exact ages in spreadsheets, with common errors.
- [Is BMI Accurate? What the Number Can't Tell You](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/guides/is-bmi-accurate/): Where BMI fails (muscle, age, build), what it gets right, and what doctors check instead.
- [All Guides](https://tulyrotools.vercel.app/guides/): Index of every guide.
